fact: IDLO's 9 May 2024 clarification to bidders on RFP N_96_2024_SOM confirms the Integrated Electronic Case Management System for Somalia's justice chain institutions was out to tender, with back-end choices of Python, PHP or ASP.NET.
title: Clarification Questions - RFP N_96_2024_SOM
